thread:
mara: heads-up — perf CI is failing on release/v0.9 after the last merge (commit 9f3c2b). seqlen=4096 jobs hit OOMs and memory fragmentation skyrocketed :warning:

jess: ugh. saw the flakes earlier but thought it was transient. link to CI: https://ci/redwood/job/4234 (logs attached) :eyes:

sam: quick skim of logs shows a bunch of `kv_cache::evict()` churn and `pagelet` allocations. suspect the new batching heuristic from #8423 widened evict window.

vikram: that matches profiling. perf-bot ran a smoke perf run: https://perf/redwood/compare/9f3c2b -> shows 2.3x memory at long seq lengths and 1.8x tail latency on 4k workloads.

perf-bot: benchmark summary: seqlen-distribution: {p50:512, p95:2048, p99:4096}, peak-resident: +120% vs baseline, kv-frag-score: +0.45.

mara: can we bisect to the exact change? last few commits touched kernel selection and batching boundary code.

sam: starting git bisect locally now. suspect range: 9eaa11..9f3c2b. repro command I used: 
```
./scripts/run_infer.sh --model t5-xl --seq-len 4096 --concurrency 12 --profile kv
```

jess: FYI the merge also updated `kv_evict_threshold` default from `0.6` -> `0.75` in runtime/config. that could explain less frequent evictions but larger fragmentation when evict windows grow.

vikram: good catch. higher threshold delays compaction, and combined with larger autobatch windows it creates bigger hot slabs. suggests interaction bug between kernel routing and eviction heuristics.

sam: bisect fast-forwarded to commit 9eeb5c which flips batching boundary scalar and touches kernel_router. repro reproduces there.

mara: given this is blocking release and CI gating, propose holding rollout and reverting 9eeb5c until we have a fix. thoughts? :hammer_and_wrench:

jess: agree. quick revert of the batching change seems safest. we should also add a CI perf test with seqlen=4k to catch regressions.

vikram: I'll prepare a small patch to revert the batching scalar and restore `kv_evict_threshold=0.6` default in a single revert PR. will include reproducer and perf traces.

mara: sounds good. deploy-bot, please pause any auto-rollouts for release/v0.9 until PR lands and CI green.

deploy-bot: auto-rollouts paused for release/v0.9 (reason: perf-gate fail). ticket created: RH-3842.

perf-bot: once revert PR is up, I'll run the seqlen=4k perf job and post comparison. recommend adding an integration test exercising KV fragmentation metrics.

mara: thanks everyone. sam/vikram please coordinate on the revert and include a short blameless note for release notes. we'll reopen rollouts after perf validation. :thumbsup:
